## beacon rules lint

Validate rule files and run their embedded conformance fixtures

### Synopsis

Loads a rule file or a directory of *.rule.yaml files, validates each (structure
plus CEL compilation against the event schema), enforces the maturity gate, and runs every
embedded test fixture. Exits non-zero if anything fails. With no path, lints ./rules.

```
beacon rules lint [path] [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for lint
```
